generate_projects_from_build_files: run generate_projects.py with build JSON files to render Mako templates into project files
preprocess_build_with_plugins: run generate_projects.py with build files and auto-discovered plugins to preprocess build data into .preprocessed_build
render_mako_templates: run generate_projects.py with --templates to render .template files into output files using mako_renderer.py
test_generated_output: set TEST env var and run generate_projects.py to diff generated output against expected results
configure_parallel_jobs: run generate_projects.py with --jobs flag to control parallelism when rendering multiple templates
